title: Resolve Workload Node Set
description: Resolves the COMPLETE set of GKE nodes that hosted a workload's pods by slicing the query window (or in <50ms with 0 Cloud Logging queries when a pre-resolved timestamps/node-mapping JSON is provided), and asserts completeness. A single unsliced log query truncates at its entry cap and yields a partial node set, which silently narrows the scope of downstream hardware analysis. Workload-agnostic (k8s_container logs by pod-name prefix). If no container ever logged (UnexpectedAdmissionError, FailedScheduling, FailedMount, image pull, eviction), falls back to the pods' Kubernetes events: nodes from 'Successfully assigned <ns>/<pod> to <node>' and kubelet source.host, with pre_start_failures counting reasons and samples; node_source says which path ran (container_logs|pod_events|none). Reads retry with backoff on quota (429) and 503; failed queries are listed in query_errors and force INCOMPLETE.

expected_hosts.description: Expected TPU host count (slices x hosts_per_slice); 0 disables the completeness assertion.

cluster_name.description: Optional exact GKE cluster name; narrows every scan via an indexed resource label.

namespace.description: Optional exact Kubernetes namespace; narrows every scan via an indexed resource label.

timestamps_json.description: Optional path to pre-resolved timestamps and node-mapping JSON. When present and populated with GKE nodes, extracts the complete node set directly in <50ms with 0 Cloud Logging queries; otherwise automatically falls back to the sliced container-log scan.
